provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.en: Motion, transforms and shadows know the direction

statement.ar: كل translateX وموضع بداية الانزلاق والتدرج اللوني الأفقي والظل المزاح أفقيًا يُضرب في معامل الاتجاه. الدرج الجانبي يدخل من جهة البداية، والانتقال إلى الصفحة التالية يتحرك نحو النهاية.
statement.en: Every translateX, slide origin, horizontal gradient and horizontally offset shadow is multiplied by a direction factor. A side drawer enters from the start side, and a forward page transition moves toward the end.

rationale.ar: الخصائص المنطقية لا تغطي التحويلات والحركة، فتبقى الحركة بالاتجاه القديم بعد قلب التخطيط.
rationale.en: Logical properties do not cover transforms and animation, so motion keeps its old direction after the layout flips.

checks: No transform with a non-zero horizontal translation appears in CSS without a direction variable or a paired [dir] rule.
In RTL a start-side drawer's first animation frame is beyond the right edge.
Horizontal gradients and offset shadows that indicate scroll or elevation direction are mirrored in RTL.
